name: breckr
description: Self-hosted web task monitor: scheduled browser tasks, condition checks, Telegram alerts

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@breckr/server && npm run build --workspace=@breckr/dashboard

//overrides: brake-ui depends on react-popper@2, whose peer range stops at React 18, so npm installs a second nested React alongside ours. Two React copies in one tree throw 'Invalid hook call' as soon as a component from the wrong copy uses hooks. react-popper itself works fine on 19 — its metadata is just stale — so pin every react to one version.
